settings.title: Black keeps it structured.
settings.text: Black details make a white bag feel intentional and easier to maintain visually.

settings.title: Navy makes it athletic.
settings.text: Navy is a safe premium accent for white bags, especially when you want less contrast than black.

settings.title: Green brings the golf signal.
settings.text: Green works when it is repeated lightly across the towel, marker, or cart piece.

settings.title: Keep it bright
settings.text: Let the white base stay clean and simple.

settings.title: Use one dark accent
settings.text: Black, navy, or green will give the setup enough structure.

settings.title: Repeat sparingly
settings.text: White bags look best when the accent is precise, not everywhere.

settings.heading: Build around a white bag.
settings.subheading: White bags look premium when the accent is simple, dark, and repeated with restraint.
